gen-fs-excon-gf-ovo: Ovo's tall middle band and barely-there thinning give it a classic serif feel, while Excon packs its towering lowercase tight. Paragraphs would glide along with a quiet, bookish authority.
gen-fs-excon-gf-spline-sans-mono: Spline Sans Mono is a monospace with lowercase nearly matching its capitals and strokes that never thicken or thin. Excon excels at tight, towering display; the mono, at precise code-style lines.
gen-fs-excon-gf-victor-mono: Towering lowercase letters, crowded together like chalk marks, give Excon its punch. Victor Mono counters with loose spacing and bowls left unfinished on one side, a monospace that looks magnified.
gen-fs-kalam-fs-tabular: Warm, scribbled, snug: Kalam looks hand-drawn with its lines bundled tight. Tabular is the sharp counterpoint, a monospace of neon-tube strokes that is best saved for a couple of lines.
gen-fs-khand-gf-hepta-slab: Khand packs its crisp, stencil-tight letters close together, with no swing from heavy to light in any stroke. Hepta Slab, a serif with stretched-out words and open counters, would keep paragraphs breathing easily.
gen-fs-khand-gf-kiwi-maru: Crisp and contemporary, Khand holds its letters tight with strokes that never shift from heavy to light. Kiwi Maru, a serif with generous letterspace and terminals stopping far from the stem, makes paragraphs feel unhurried.
gen-fs-khand-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Khand packs crisp letters close, while Padyakke Expanded One spreads wide-mouthed glyphs along the line like knots on a rope. That text serif feel makes long paragraphs read as literary and slow.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-lora: Round letters bent like wire, horizontals matching verticals, give Kohinoor Zerone its precise, contemporary look. Lora adds a broad-mouthed c and mild hairline thinning, so brief reading feels bookish.
gen-fs-new-title-dm-sans: DM Sans reads friendly and open, with wide-set terminals on the s and a moderate lowercase height. But New Title's tall lowercase, locked like chain links, stands higher, so give DM Sans a generous size.
gen-fs-new-title-fs-literata: New Title's tall lowercase, locked together like links in a fine chain, rises well above the moderate height of Literata. Literata, a serif with gently varied strokes, gives the heading a bookish counterweight.
